svg.aria-label: the parameter square of a bumpy surface cut by a plane, shaded where the surface is above the plane, with a coarse grid of sample points; one branch of the intersection runs between two points on the boundary, and a small closed loop sits between the samples, round a marked point at the top of a narrow bump
svg.text: A PLANE ACROSS A BUMPY SURFACE
a closed loop touching no edge
surrounds the top of the bump (x),
to the plane’s, and a ray
